items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I don't know who you take Piku.

ctx.x: Very seldom. Very seldom. Very seldom. Very seldom. Not too much, not like hand in. Oh well no.
Would you compare yourself from the style of Piku or?
Oh no, those men were superior to me 100%. They don't come to a better than them kind men when he was at his prime, you know. I don't know who you take Piku.
